## MSI status

Microsatellite instability (MSI) is the result of impaired DNA mismatch repair and constitutes a cellular phenotype of clinical significance in many cancer types, most prominently colorectal cancers, stomach cancers, endometrial cancers, and ovarian cancers ([Cortes-Ciriano et al., 2017](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/28585546)).

```{r msi_layout}
#| echo: false

## Result from an external MSI caller and a prediction from the PCGR MSI classifier
## are shown side by side (tabs) when both are available
msi_ext_eval <- isTRUE(pcg_report$content$msi$external$eval)
msi_clf_eval <- isTRUE(pcg_report$content$msi$eval) &&
  isFALSE(pcg_report$content$msi$missing_data)
msi_tabs <- msi_ext_eval && msi_clf_eval
msi_tab_ext <- "External MSI caller"
msi_tab_clf <- "PCGR MSI classifier"
```

```{r msi_open_tabset}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr msi_tabs
#| output: asis

cat("\n::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
```

```{r msi_heading_external}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr msi_ext_eval
#| output: asis

cat("\n### ", if (msi_tabs) msi_tab_ext else "MSI status from external MSI caller", "\n\n", sep = "")
```

```{r pcgr_msi_external}
#| child: 'pcgr_quarto_report/msi/external.qmd'
#| eval: !expr msi_ext_eval

```

```{r msi_heading_classifier}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr msi_clf_eval
#| output: asis

cat("\n### ", if (msi_tabs) msi_tab_clf else "MSI classifier prediction", "\n\n", sep = "")
```

```{r pcgr_msi_classifier}
#| child: 'pcgr_quarto_report/msi/classifier.qmd'
#| eval: !expr msi_clf_eval

```

```{r msi_close_tabset}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr msi_tabs
#| output: asis

cat("\n:::\n\n")
```
